Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Perplexity's loader morph - while the answer streams, a small circular button with the spinning logo sits at the bottom center; when streaming finishes, the circle smoothly morphs into the wide "Ask follow up..." text input with its mic icon.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
The Answer page: streaming response text with citation numbers fills the viewport. At the bottom center sits a circular floating button with the Perplexity knot logo; end state is a full-width rounded input bar with "Ask follow up..." placeholder and a mic icon on the right.

## Motion spec
Pattern: container morph from circle to input bar.
- During streaming: the circular button's logo spins continuously (~1.2s per revolution) - the only indicator that work continues.
- On stream complete: the circle expands horizontally (width animates 44px -> full bar width, 400ms, ease-in-out) while its height eases to the bar's height - one shape becoming the other, no swap.
- The spinning logo shrinks and docks to the left inside the emerging bar (scale 1 -> 0.7, translating to the leading edge) and stops spinning.
- The placeholder text "Ask follow up..." and the mic icon fade in once the bar is ~80% formed (150ms fade) - content arrives after geometry.
- The morph is reversible: if a new answer streams, the bar contracts back to the spinning circle.

## Calibration
- The morph path is symmetric around the bar's center - it grows left and right at once.
- The logo never jumps: it is inside the morphing container the whole time.

## Reduced motion
Circle crossfades to the bar.

## Don't miss
- The circle sits above the streaming text on a subtle shadow - it is chrome, not content.
- The spin stops exactly as the morph begins - motion hands off to the morph.
